scope: Standing Bidar Fort, including the full defensive enclosure, outer bastions, remaining walls and the south-eastern gate and moat approaches. The royal precinct includes the mapped palace ruins, Naubat Khana, the Solah Khamba mosque, and Rangeen Mahal.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The government district handbook records massive mostly polygonal bastions, defended gates, a triple moat cut into laterite and the palaces, baths, kitchens, and Solah Khamba mosque.
The government tourism description identifies thick red laterite walls, multiple moat levels, proud bastions, and the historical palaces and mosque of the royal precinct.

The institutional architecture survey describes defensive gates and barbicans, two successive doors in the outer gate, and the preserved structures Rangin Mahal, Tarkash Mahal, Gagan Mahal and Takht Mahal.
